responsibility: Implements Rust’s token-stream-to-AST parser by defining the shared `Parser` state, token navigation, recovery mode, delimiter and utility infrastructure, then layering grammar-specific parsers for attributes and token capture, items and modules, statements and block contents, expressions, patterns, types, paths, generics, and macro nonterminal fragments. The module also centralizes parser-stage diagnostics, placeholder AST construction, ambiguity resolution, and syntax recovery so these subparsers cooperate to build correctly attributed AST nodes with the captured token streams needed by later compilation stages.
